hero.description: Based in Uzunköprü. I build web applications, develop mobile apps, and design custom IoT hardware. I simplify complex technology into clean, fast, and working solutions.

about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Who am I?
about.p1: I live and work in Uzunköprü, Turkey. I focus on software development, web design, and hardware engineering. From brainstorming to coding, and PCB layout to physical assembly, I handle the entire product cycle.
about.p2: I value readable code, honest communication, and solid architecture. No corporate fluff or over-engineered solutions—just software that gets the job done.

items.title: Smart Agriculture & Soil Analysis Station
items.description: An IoT system that reads real-time data such as temperature, humidity, and soil minerals from fields or greenhouses, transfers it to the cloud via cellular network, and presents it with charts on a web dashboard.

items.title: Virtual Exchange & Portfolio Tracking Portal
items.description: A comprehensive web platform where users can follow cryptocurrency and stock data in real-time with WebSockets, trade using virtual balances, and analyze their performance.

items.title: Industrial Device Management Panel (IIoT)
items.description: A highly secure industrial interface that monitors machine statuses in factory environments, predicts failures, and sends real-time push notifications to managers.
